<document id=DOC_release_note_measured>
Release 4.3 makes four changes. The export job now completes in
under 30 seconds. The login page was restyled. The importer accepts
files up to 2 GB. The help link points to the new documentation.
</document>

List the changes in the release note below.

Put every change that states a measurable quantity first, in the order
they appear, then the remaining changes.

response.text:
- The export job now completes in under 30 seconds.  
- The importer accepts files up to 2 GB.  
- The login page was restyled.  
- The help link points to the new documentation.
